exact_items: Crosswalk.md §2 routing table must add Primitive:RouteTarget pointing to Contracts_V0.md §route_target and Primitive:OpenSubject pointing to Contracts_V0.md §OpenSubject
These entries should follow the same routing-table pattern as other Crosswalk primitives
notes: Crosswalk.md must add two routing entries following existing pattern: Primitive:RouteTarget → Contracts_V0.md §route_target; Primitive:OpenSubject → Contracts_V0.md §OpenSubject

exact_items: Contracts_V0.md must define the concrete route_target shape with: target_kind (required), project_id?, focused_run_id?, thread_id?, tab_id?, subject_id?, object_kind?+object_id?, inspector_target?

The route_target shape must NOT directly carry artifact_id, document_id, usage_event_ref, wizard_id, wizard_step, message_id, workflow_run_id, scheduler_pass_id, safe_point_id, remediation_root_id, line, or range — these normalize into subject_id or object_kind+object_id
notes: Canonical route_target minimum field set: target_kind (required); project_id?, focused_run_id?, thread_id?, tab_id?; subject_id? OR object_kind?+object_id?; inspector_target?. Surface-specific IDs (artifact_id, document_id, etc.) normalize into subject_id or object_kind+object_id and must NOT be base fields.

exact_items: Contracts_V0.md must define the concrete OpenSubject shape — the contract for identity-native object opens that are distinct from workspace-file path operations
UICommand.args for navigation commands must reference the canonical route_target shape rather than ad hoc per-command field lists
notes: OpenSubject concrete shape in Contracts_V0.md must cover: subject_kind (required), subject_id (required), optional context fields (project_id, focused_run_id, thread_id). UICommand.args for nav commands must reference route_target by contract ref.

exact_items: FileManager.md OpenFile must be narrowed to workspace-document path operations only
Any OpenFile usage that currently covers identity-native subject/route opens must be split out into the OpenSubject contract family
notes: FileManager.md OpenFile narrowing is a concrete scope change: the contract text must be limited to 'workspace-document path operation only; for identity-native object opens, use OpenSubject in Contracts_V0.md'

exact_items: UI_Command_Catalog.md must introduce a cmd.nav.* command family that provides canonical wrapper functions for all navigation and subject-open operations

The family should include at minimum: cmd.nav.open_subject (routes through OpenSubject contract), cmd.nav.focus_route (routes through route_target contract), cmd.nav.open_file (workspace path operation, delegates to FileManager contract)
notes: cmd.nav.* family registration: cmd.nav.open_subject (args: OpenSubject), cmd.nav.focus_route (args: route_target), cmd.nav.open_file (args: file path). Wiring rows in Wiring_Matrix.md must follow.

exact_items: FinalGUISpec.md must be updated to reference both: the workspace file open contract (OpenFile via cmd.nav.open_file), and the identity-native subject/route open contract (OpenSubject via cmd.nav.open_subject)
The current spec conflates both operations under a single 'open' affordance that maps to workspace file semantics only
notes: FinalGUISpec.md must distinguish workspace-file opens (OpenFile/cmd.nav.open_file) from identity-native subject opens (OpenSubject/cmd.nav.open_subject) at the spec level

exact_items: assistant-chat-design.md and storage-plan.md must both explicitly state that resume_url is a serialized transport form only — not the canonical route contract
resume_url must reference the canonical route_target contract as the primary model, with resume_url noted as a URL-serialized projection of that model
notes: resume_url demotion from canonical to transport-only is a three-doc fix: Contracts_V0.md (seed-WAVE006-0074), storage-plan.md (seed-WAVE006-0084), and assistant-chat-design.md (this seed)

exact_items: Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md must be updated to consume the shared route_target / subject-open resolver rather than implementing its own panel-local navigation routing
The panel's 'Show in *' actions and artifact activation flows should all dispatch through cmd.nav.* with canonical route_target payloads
notes: Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md must reference cmd.nav.* / route_target for all panel-navigation actions. Panel-local routing implementations will diverge without this.

exact_items: FinalGUISpec.md and UI_Command_Catalog.md must both reference the canonical route-target model for: search result activation, CtA activation, artifact Show-in-* actions, and usage pivot actions
All four surface activation patterns must converge on route_target + cmd.nav.* family rather than maintaining separate per-surface implementation conventions
notes: Four surface activation patterns that must converge on route_target + cmd.nav.*: (1) search result click, (2) CtA item activation, (3) artifact Show-in-* actions, (4) usage pivot links. Both FinalGUISpec.md and UI_Command_Catalog.md must explicitly reference the canonical model.
